meta.title: Activating a withdrawn event is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_withdraw_…”.
The buyer updates the event with the status set to “active”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals withdrawn.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals withdrawn.
